stem:
Study the table and answer the question that follows.

Workers, Aged 10–14, in the United States: 1870–1930 (thousands)

Which reason contributed to the trend shown in this table?

options.label: A
options.text: The number of factories using assembly lines decreased.

options.label: B
options.text: A progressive movement worked to stop the use of child labor.

options.label: C
options.text: A political movement worked to lower taxes for businesses.

options.label: D
options.text: The number of people joining labor unions decreased.
